+1 to the rating of any one Attribute except Essence, Reaction or Magic. Pick the Attribute on this item's sheet; the bonus applies automatically and does not spend character-creation Attribute Points.

Players can take no more than 5 bonus Attribute Points. Unless the gamemaster authorizes it, they cannot raise an Attribute beyond the character's racial maximum — take Exceptional Attribute to raise the maximum itself. A bonus Attribute Point used to go past the original racial maximum has an Edge value of 2 rather than 1; set the Point Value accordingly. (Shadowrun Companion p.24)
